violations.text: Inspector observed cat litter in bathroom area of establishment. PIC informed to remove all pets and pet equipment for establishment. New Violation. Correct By: 06/30/2026

Unnecessary and/or non-functional equipment or items were observed in the (retail) area. Establishments shall be kept free of unnecessary and/or non-functional equipment and litter to prevent harborage conditions. New Violation. Correct By: 07/30/2026

The following physical facilities are in poor repair: -ceilings have water stains and missing tiles. -floors in retail area have damaged tiles and missing coving under 3 bay sink. -walls in back retail area have holes. The physical facilities must be maintained in good repair. New Violation. Correct By: 06/30/2026
